text: The model flagged the applicant as high risk because three key pieces of information pushed the default probability upward. First, the revolving‑credit utilization is essentially at 100 %, meaning the applicant is using almost all of the credit that is available to them; this pattern is strongly associated with a higher chance of missing payments. Second, the applicant currently has three real‑estate loans or mortgages, and having several large, long‑term debts adds to the overall burden, further raising risk. Finally, at 42 years old, the age profile in this data set is linked to a slightly higher likelihood of default compared with younger borrowers. Together, these factors led the model to assign a 68.4 % probability of default and label the application as high risk.
